summary: legal checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising expansion. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, authorize only internal evidence and unsent permission-request preparation, and do not launch, monetize, expand alerts, enable new tracking, or send external outreach. Evidence: Woot API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established and current public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth where consent, disclosures, claims, provenance, rights, and platform boundaries are preserved. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; no task is closed because complete evidence is absent. Source-rights evidence is partial and remains blocked. Data-flow evidence is partial from repository/configuration artifacts. Privacy and cookie documents exist, but deployed consent behavior, GA4 settings, retention, vendor/DPA, log, incident, deletion, correction, and access evidence remain open. Next evidence action: attach one read-only artifact covering alert and operational data flows, log fields, retention, access, deletion, correction, notification consent/unsubscribe, vendors, and incident/request procedures; separately attach a field-level rights matrix and unsent permission-request draft. Do not close tasks until evidence is complete and unresolved issues are routed to human counsel.
